news.h: Sources: Jaguars LT Harrison out for season after surgery reveals torn ACL
news.d: Jaguars left tackle Anton Harrison will miss the rest of the season because of a torn ACL in his right knee, league sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

news.h: Sources: Jaguars LT Anton Harrison to undergo knee surgery
news.d: Jaguars left tackle Anton Harrison will have arthroscopic surgery on his right knee when the team returns from London next week, league sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and 's Jeremy Fowler.
